compiled_state.title: As a DSO operator, oversized PRs are reviewed via chunked file-level dispatch with LLM aggregation rather than failing on cumulative diff
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Extend the `dso_ci_review` runner to pre-filter non-reviewable files (via `.gitattributes` linguist tags PLUS additive configurable `ignore.glob`/`ignore.regex`), then chunk per-file when the filtered diff still exceeds threshold. Add an LLM aggregation pass that synthesizes cross-file findings, a visibility trailer listing reviewed and skipped files (with skip reason), and a hard upper bound `max_files × max_calls` that routes to admin/FP-recovery via a distinct `OVER_BOUND` status.

**Why**: Today the LLM returns non-JSON output on 6000+ line cumulative diffs and schema correction exhausts, failing the review closed and blocking merges. Chunked review with aggregation lets the runner handle arbitrarily large PRs gracefully while preserving review fidelity for cross-file findings.

**Scope**:
- IN: Runner pre-filter logic; file-level chunking extending `region_split.py` Strategy E (preserves the file-atomicity invariant); LLM aggregation pass; visibility trailer (namespaced to avoid collision with `DSO-Story-Merge:`); `OVER_BOUND` hard-bound status; non-empty default `ignore.glob` values; `max_files`/`max_calls` non-zero validation at config load.
- OUT: Per-sub-PR review workflow itself (S1); cycle ledger keying (S2); RED-test-blocker (S4).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the runner pre-filters non-reviewable files via `.gitattributes` linguist tags (`linguist-generated`, `linguist-vendored`, `linguist-documentation`) PLUS additive configurable `ignore.glob` / `ignore.regex` overrides. `ignore.glob` ships with non-empty defaults (`**/package-lock.json`, `**/yarn.lock`, `**/poetry.lock`, `**/go.sum` at minimum). `max_files` and `max_calls` validate non-zero at config load with a warning on zero.
  ← Satisfies: "The runner pre-filters non-reviewable files via .gitattributes linguist tags PLUS additive configurable ignore.glob / ignore.regex overrides. ignore.glob ships with a non-empty default value"

- When this story is complete, file-level chunking EXTENDS the existing per-directory region-split (Strategy E in `region_split.py`) with finer-grain per-file dispatch for oversized single-file or single-directory clusters, preserving the file-atomicity invariant (`RegionSplitInvariantError` is NOT raised). The chunker reuses the primary→fallback model chain, schema correction loop, novelty gates, and DefenseStore.
  ← Satisfies: "File-level chunking EXTENDS the existing per-directory region-split with finer-grain per-file dispatch... preserving the file-atomicity invariant"

- When this story is complete, an LLM aggregation pass synthesizes cross-file findings before posting. The aggregated PR comment includes a visibility trailer listing every file reviewed and every file skipped with skip reason. The visibility trailer uses a key distinct from `DSO-Story-Merge:` and any other provenance grammar (recommended namespace: `DSO-Review-Coverage:` or `DSO-OverBound:`).
  ← Satisfies: SC2 + Red team Finding #9 (trailer namespace)

- When this story is complete, the LLM aggregation pass does NOT write a separate ledger entry per cluster — a single (pr_number, sha, cycle_num) tuple corresponds to exactly one cycle ledger entry regardless of how many clusters or per-file dispatches were involved. A unit test in this story asserts: a region-split run produces exactly one ledger entry per (pr_number, sha, cycle_num) tuple.
  ← Satisfies: Red team Finding #8 (aggregation pass cycle counting)

- When this story is complete, a hard upper bound `max_files × max_calls` routes oversized PRs to admin/FP-recovery via a distinct `OVER_BOUND` status (NOT `FP-suspected`). `/dso:fp-recovery` rejects PRs with `OVER_BOUND` status, preserving FP-recovery's signal integrity.
  ← Satisfies: SC2 + scenario mitigation (FP-recovery erosion)

- When this story is complete, two synthetic fixtures pass: (a) 7000+ line direct PR with mixed reviewable/ignored files produces aggregated findings with visibility trailer and the LLM never receives the full diff; (b) 200-file synthetic PR routes to admin/FP-recovery without silent passing.
  ← Satisfies: "synthetic 7000+ line direct PR with mixed reviewable/ignored files produces aggregated findings with visibility trailer; the LLM never receives the full diff; a 200-file synthetic PR routes to FP-recovery without silent passing"

- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic.
  ← Satisfies: TDD Done-of-Done requirement

## Considerations

- [Correctness] File-level chunking strips cross-file context — the aggregation pass partially mitigates but does not eliminate the gap. This is an ACCEPTED OPERATIONAL CONSTRAINT documented in the runner output and the doc-story's known-limitations section.
- [Correctness] The visibility trailer text MUST NOT match the prefix that `verify-session-provenance.sh:137` greps for (`^DSO-Story-Merge:`). Pick a distinct namespace and lock the grammar with a contract test.
- [Performance] Per-file dispatch is empirically dominant (Phelps' production sidebar) but the aggregation pass adds an extra LLM call per oversized PR. Confirm the aggregation pass cost is bounded by `max_calls` (NOT `max_files × max_calls`).

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
